transcript.speaker: Diana Prince
transcript.text: Thanks for taking the time, George. I want to show you the updated user onboarding flow.

transcript.speaker: Diana Prince
transcript.text: We've simplified the signup steps based on the feedback from last month.

transcript.speaker: George King
transcript.text: Great, let's see it. Oh, I like how you combined the profile setup and team invite into one screen.

transcript.speaker: George King
transcript.text: That's much cleaner. Did it improve the drop-off metrics?

transcript.speaker: Diana Prince
transcript.text: Yes, exactly. Our metrics showed a big drop-off there. This new flow increased completion by 15%.

transcript.speaker: George King
transcript.text: A 15% increase is massive! That's equivalent to an extra $50,000 in projected revenue this quarter.

transcript.speaker: Diana Prince
transcript.text: However, I'm unsure about the color contrast on the primary CTA button. Do you think it's accessible?

transcript.speaker: George King
transcript.text: Hmm, let me run it through the contrast checker right now.

transcript.speaker: George King
transcript.text: Yeah, it's a bit low. We should probably darken the purple shade slightly.

transcript.speaker: Diana Prince
transcript.text: Okay, I'll make a note to adjust the CTA colors for accessibility.

transcript.speaker: George King
transcript.text: Will you have it done by tomorrow?

transcript.speaker: Diana Prince
transcript.text: I will have the final version ready by tomorrow's sync at 10 AM.

transcript.speaker: George King
transcript.text: Awesome. The rest of the flow looks solid to me.

transcript.speaker: George King
transcript.text: I will assign a frontend developer to start scoping out the work on Monday.

transcript.speaker: Diana Prince
transcript.text: Sounds perfect. Is there anything else you want to review today?

transcript.speaker: George King
transcript.text: No, I think we are all good here. Have a great weekend!

summary.overview_text: Review of the new onboarding flow design. The consolidated profile setup screen was approved. A contrast issue on the primary CTA button was identified and will be fixed by Diana before the next sync.

action_items.text: Adjust CTA button color for accessibility
Prepare final version for tomorrow's sync at 10 AM
Assign a frontend developer to scope work on Monday
